content.short: tApps Center is the official directory for Telegram Mini Apps and bots within the TON ecosystem.
content.description: tApps Center is the definitive and official directory for discovering the vast array of Telegram Mini Apps (TMAs) and bots operating on the TON blockchain. It serves as a centralized hub for millions of Telegram users to explore and access high-quality games, DeFi tools, and utility applications. By providing a curated and verified list of projects, tApps Center ensures a safe and efficient discovery process, helping users navigate the rapidly growing TON ecosystem while providing developers with a powerful platform to reach their target audience.
